name: JC Christoff
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
description: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and Medicare provider with over 20 years' experience. 'They specialise in offering deeply affirming, non-judgemental spaces for LGBTQIA+, non-binary, trans, polyamorous, and kink-aligned individuals.' Existential Psychotherapy, Narrative Therapy, trauma-informed care, somatic integration; gender transition support, kink/BDSM friendly therapy, complex trauma. Thursdays in Carlton or online; Fridays online.
specialties: trans and gender diverse, non-binary, gender transition support, LGBTQIA+, polyamory, kink/BDSM, complex trauma, existential psychotherapy, neurodivergence

name: Malan van der Walt
title: Registered Psychologist
description: AHPRA-registered psychologist with a decade in mental health, working with adults through anxiety, depression, ADHD, grief, and trauma. 'As a queer practitioner, he brings genuine lived understanding to work with LGBTQIA+ clients and communities.' Draws on EMDR and ACT alongside psychodynamic approaches, plus CBT and DBT. Fridays in-person in Carlton; telehealth by arrangement; accepts Mental Health Care Plans.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, complex presentations, LGBTQIA+, ADHD, psychodynamic, DBT

name: Meg A. Wilson
title: Founder, Psychotherapist
description: Founder and lead psychotherapist; integrates clinical psychotherapy with creative art therapies and systemic relationship models, with a special focus on non-typical relationship structures. Areas: polyamory & ethical non-monogamy, relationship anarchy, LGBTQIA+ & queer affirming space, kink & sex-positive practice, complex trauma & relational distress, psychedelic integration. New clients waitlisted.
specialties: art psychotherapy, polyamory, relationship anarchy, LGBTQIA+, queer, kink, sex-positive, complex trauma, psychedelic integration, DBT

name: Nash Mbani
title: Counsellor & Mental Health Nurse
description: South African-born, Melbourne-based therapist working with couples and individuals on relationships, including people in polyamorous and non-monogamous partnerships. 20+ years as a psychiatric nurse; Master of Holistic Counselling; somatic work and nervous system regulation. Areas include anxiety & trauma, kink relationships, CALD community.
specialties: couples, polyamory, non-monogamy, kink relationships, somatic therapy, trauma, CALD

name: Natasha Lama
title: Counsellor & Sex Therapist
description: Registered psychotherapist with a Master's in Counselling and specialised clinical training in sex therapy. 'She offers inclusive sex therapy, multicultural counselling, and sex-positive, relationship-diverse care.' Areas: sexual dysfunction & pain, intimacy & desire differences, polyamory & open relationships, LGBTQIA+ & queer sex positive space. Online only for now (Mon, Tue, Sat).
specialties: sex therapy, sexual dysfunction, desire differences, polyamory, LGBTQIA+, queer, multicultural counselling, CALD

name: Sam Beer
title: Somatic Sexologist & Intimacy Coach
description: Somatic sexologist and intimacy coach working with individuals, couples and groups on sex, pleasure and connection; body-based rather than talk-only. 'Sam is trained in trauma-informed practice.' No direct touch in sessions. Somatic Sex Education, Embodied Counselling, Somatic Attachment Therapy, Wheel of Consent.
specialties: somatic sexology, sex, pleasure, desire, intimacy, consent, trauma-informed, couples

name: Nicki Nelis
title: Counsellor (Gestalt therapist)
description: Gestalt therapist with nearly 20 years of experience helping young people and adults navigate transitions; a warm, relational space to explore identity, self-esteem, grief, and relationship patterns. Areas include anxiety and trauma, identity exploration. Wed evenings online; Thursdays in Carlton or online.
specialties: gestalt therapy, identity exploration, trauma, grief, young adults

name: Emma Steains
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical psychologist providing a warm, strengths-based, and neurodivergent-affirming environment for young people (16+) and adults; uses CBT, ACT and Schema Therapy; self-identity & adjustment. On leave — not taking new clients.
specialties: schema therapy, neurodivergent affirming, ADHD, autism, self-identity
